title: SSL certificate expiry causing HTTPS failures
symptoms: Browser showing NET::ERR_CERT_DATE_INVALID. Nginx error log: SSL_CTX_use_certificate_file failed (SSL: error:0B080074:x509 certificate routines). API clients receiving: requests.exceptions.SSLError: certificate verify failed. 100% of HTTPS traffic failing.
root_cause: The Let's Encrypt certificate for api.company.com expired. The auto-renewal cron job (certbot renew) had been silently failing for 30 days because the user running certbot lacked write permissions to the /etc/letsencrypt directory after an OS security update changed file ownership.
fix_applied: 1. Manually renewed certificate: certbot certonly --webroot. 2. Reloaded nginx: nginx -s reload. 3. Fixed certbot cron job permissions: chown -R certbot:certbot /etc/letsencrypt. 4. Added certificate expiry monitoring alert at 30 and 7 days. 5. Documented renewal runbook.
